name: Watchdog
description: Watches the front-door camera feed: daily summaries and honest statistics — how many times the dog went out, how long the kids played outside.
description_zh: 盯着门口摄像头：每日总结与真实统计——狗出门几次、孩子在外面玩了多久。

suggested_channels.reason: The camera device publishes doorway events into this feed; without it the watchdog is blind.
suggested_channels.reason_zh: 门口摄像头把事件发布到这个频道；没有它，看门狗什么也看不见。

suggested_channels.reason: Daily summaries and unusual-activity notes reach the family over the WeChat gateway.
suggested_channels.reason_zh: 每日总结与异常提醒通过微信网关送达家人。

suggested_context.reason: Knowing who and what belongs (family members, the dog, regular visitors) separates routine from unusual.
suggested_context.reason_zh: 知道谁是家人、哪只是自家的狗、谁常来访，才能分清日常与异常。

schedule.label: Daily doorway summary
schedule.prompt: Summarize today's doorway events from your memory statistics: dog outings (count, longest), kids' outdoor play (total duration), deliveries and visitors, anything unusual. Publish the summary to the granted channels.
